subject: feat(facets): when * is present, only send that parameter (algolia/algoliasearch-helper-js#874)
bodyLines: * feat(facets): add expandWildcardFacets parameter to process * in facets
When * is present in facets, we don't need to request the individual facet values of each facet that's declared, as * will already request it.
